skills.name: Separate whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Interpret mixed numbers and whole numbers as a sum of a whole part and a fraction part, including representing a whole number as a mixed number with zero numerator.

skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Determine the least common denominator of two fractions and rewrite each as an equivalent fraction with that denominator.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with common denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator and write the result over that denominator.

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: When the fraction part of the difference is negative, decrease the whole part by 1, add the denominator to the numerator of the fraction part, and then subtract again.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common divisor.
